# 📊 Log Analyzer

A simple Python-based **security log analyzer** that parses log files, identifies common errors, tracks IP addresses, and flags IPs generating repeated errors.

## 🚀 Features

* Parses structured log files using Regex
* Counts log levels (`INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR`, `CRITICAL`)
* Identifies the top 10 common errors
* Extracts IPv4 addresses from log messages
* Tracks errors generated by each IP
* Flags suspicious IPs based on an error threshold
* Handles invalid file paths and file-reading errors

## 🛠️ Technologies

* Python 3
* Regular Expressions (`re`)
* `Counter`
* `pathlib`

No external libraries are required.

## 📋 Log Format

```text
2026-08-30 20:15:32 [ERROR] Connection failed from 192.168.1.10
2026-08-30 20:16:10 [INFO] User logged in successfully
2026-08-30 20:17:45 [CRITICAL] Service failed from 192.168.1.20
```

## ▶️ Usage

Run the script:

```bash
python log_analyzer.py
```

Then enter the path of your log file:

```text
Pls Enter a valid file path: sample.log
```

## 🚨 Detection

An IP is flagged when it generates **3 or more ERROR/CRITICAL logs**.

```text
⚠️ ALERT: IP 192.168.1.10 triggered 4 error logs!
```

## 🎯 Purpose

This project was created to practice **Python, Regex, log analysis, and basic cybersecurity threat detection**.
